title: SweetPotatOS Fourth Harvest — Swirl desktop screencast
description:
SweetPotatOS Fourth Harvest is an Arch-based Linux distro with a live ISO, the SweetPotato Swirl desktop, and a Calamares installer, made for slow older computers.

This is a 2m 36s tour of the Fourth Harvest desktop: overview, tiling, themes, Laniakea wallpapers, Smart Brightness, and the rolling update channel.

Download the ISO: https://sourceforge.net/projects/sweetpotatos/files/2026.10_Fourth_Harvest/
Showroom: https://sweetpotatos.sourceforge.io/showroom.html
Changelog: https://sweetpotatos.sourceforge.io/changelog.html
Project page: https://sourceforge.net/projects/sweetpotatos/
Source: https://github.com/visnudeva/SweetPotatOs
Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@SweetPotat-Os

What you see
• Swirl desktop on the Fourth Harvest live ISO
• Overview (Mod+Tab), tiling, status bar, and themes
• Laniakea generative wallpapers
• Smart Brightness for fullscreen video
• Stay current with: sudo sweetpotatos-update
